sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Ishan Deo Giri
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Manish Kumar Nigam,J.
1.

The prayer made in the instant petition is for a direction to respondent no. 4 to release the arrears of compensation amount to the petitioners in terms of report of Revenue Inspector dated 19.10.2022, wherein it is stated that compensation was paid to the affected persons in terms of the award at normal rate.

It is stated that the initial recommendation was based on width of road being 0.4 mtrs. and now a fresh report has been submitted.
2. The case of the petitioners is that on account of an error, they have not been paid compensation by applying correct rates.

1

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
3. Learned Standing Counsel is in receipt of written instructions from the competent authority and according to which compensation has been paid to the petitioners in terms of award and in case,
they are aggrieved thereby, it is open to them to seek reference under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation & Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation & Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation & Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation & Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 4. Counsel for the petitioners states that the petitioners would avail the said remedy.

5. Accordingly and having regard to the submission made, we dispose of the instant petition with liberty to the petitioners to avail the remedy of reference under Section 64 of the Act, if so advised.
6. This order has been passed in presence of Sri S.C. Dwivedi, counsel for the respondent nos. 2 and 3.

Order Date :- 8.7.2024 Nitika Sri. (Manish Kumar Nigam, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.)
